title: Grid Interconnection Queue Reform
summary: Policy and process changes aimed at shortening multi-year grid connection queues.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Policy and process reforms to streamline grid connection approvals (currently 7-year waits in Virginia); binding timelines, penalties for speculative filings, shovel-ready priority..

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

Grid interconnection queues total 1.84 TW nationally, exceeding total US installed generation capacity. Average wait: 7 years in Northern Virginia. Reform is single most binding near-term constraint. Allianz Research 2026.
